rationale: Both options test several value types. Option A is cheaper and includes a neutral control, which suits a resource-conscious evaluator who wants a lightweight, portable design. Option B covers multiple frontier models and includes developer loyalty, which is relevant to the original company-dependent shift, but it costs more and has no control. Against that, the persona also values coverage and diversity, and B's multi-model scope and varied value types fit that. These considerations roughly offset, so the split is near even.
